source_access.scope: The selected normal cache is abstract-only. Actual author-uploaded full text was independently read through ResearchGate: patient fractionation, BFA/GM130 rescue Results and selected Methods. The institutional PDF route returned a 403 challenge, not a usable PDF. The BFA assay measures Golgi-to-ER redistribution.

Selected full BFG-Y2H Results and assay Methods passages were read. All 16 literal target/paper/partner records for eight source pairs were authenticated; screen host and product features remain distinct from native human mechanisms.
Selected full BioPlex 2.0 Results and AP-MS Methods were read. The single exact COG6/WASHC3 record is positive; AP-MS co-association is not automatically a purified binary interaction.

The selected main cache is abstract-only. Original indexed Methods/Results were separately accessed through the authenticated COG4/core source packet and ROOT’s bounded COG6 consultation: human constructs in reticulocyte lysate, cooperative COG6 incorporation, no purified binary COG6 interface claim.

Selected full Methods/Results and textual legends were inspected for human COG6 knockout, subunit stability and EM morphology. The paper explicitly exempts COG6 from immature cathepsin-D secretion; representative toxin assays are not generalized to an uninspected COG6 panel.

The protected cache provides the abstract and Introduction/Discussion, not full Methods/Results. Both exact BioPlex COG6/SNAP29 records were independently authenticated, with their actual assay hosts; later mechanistic SNAP29 support is separately cited.

Selected Results, Discussion and assay/validation legends were read. All 168 exact records for 56 target/paper/partner pairs were authenticated. Global MAPPIT/GPCA validation is not assigned to each COG6 pair.

Selected full Results and Methods for SARS-CoV-2/human binary contact mapping were inspected. Six exact records map COG6 to processed nsp14 and nsp16; both product sequences match their recorded checksums. A human physiological or infection-essential role is not inferred.

Genuine full text: selected human knockdown, endogenous association, recombinant interaction, SNARE assembly and rescue Results/Methods were read. Purified directness is established for COG6/STX6; the proposed conformational mechanism is an interpretation. The STx-B/TGN38 cargo assays resolve endosome-to-TGN retrieval; BFA redistribution is Golgi-to-ER. These are not direct intra-Golgi cargo assays. The follow-up adds the route-specific process after participation, comparator and typed coverage checks.

Genuine full text: selected human construct, directed Y2H, co-IP, recombinant binding, mislocalization and Golgi-morphology Results/Methods were read. Purified GS27/STX6 binding is distinct from SNAP29 Y2H/co-IP; artificial mitochondrial recruitment does not imply native mitochondrial localization. STX5 is supported by directed Y2H and weaker reproducible cellular association; that is not a purified STX5-binding experiment. Rab6(Q72L) artificial recruitment does not alone resolve human RAB6B specificity.

The genuine complete abstract supports a distinct COG6-deficient clinical presentation, reduced COG6/STX6 and a normal transferrin glycosylation profile. No full Results/Methods read or universal genotype–phenotype rule is claimed.
Normal abstract plus separately indexed original selected Methods, Table I, Results and Figure 3 legend; figure pixels and exact Cog6 clone boundaries uninspected.

ontology.label: protein-macromolecule adaptor activity
ontology.definition: An adaptor activity that brings together two or more macromolecules in contact, permitting those molecules to function in a coordinated way. The adaptor can bring together two proteins, or a protein and another macromolecule such as a lipid or a nucleic acid.

ontology.label: enzyme binding
ontology.definition: Binding to an enzyme, a protein with catalytic activity.

ontology.label: protein binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a protein.

ontology.label: COG complex
ontology.definition: A multisubunit tethering complex of the CATCHR family (complexes associated with tethering containing helical rods) that has a role in tethering vesicles to the Golgi prior to fusion. Composed of 8 subunits COG1-8.

ontology.label: protein domain specific binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a specific domain of a protein.

ontology.label: helical-bundle zippering fusogenic activity
ontology.definition: Acting as a marker to identify a membrane and interacting selectively with one or more SNAREs on another membrane to mediate membrane fusion.

ontology.label: intra-Golgi vesicle-mediated transport
ontology.definition: The directed movement of substances within the Golgi, mediated by small transport vesicles. These either fuse with the cis-Golgi or with each other to form the membrane stacks known as the cis-Golgi reticulum (network).

ontology.label: Golgi membrane
ontology.definition: The lipid bilayer surrounding any of the compartments of the Golgi apparatus.

ontology.label: retrograde transport, vesicle recycling within Golgi
ontology.definition: The retrograde movement of substances within the Golgi, mediated by COP I vesicles. Cis-Golgi vesicles are constantly moving forward through the Golgi stack by cisternal progression, eventually becoming trans-Golgi vesicles. They then selectively transport membrane and luminal proteins from the trans- to the medial-Golgi while leaving others behind in the trans-Golgi cisternae; similarly, they selectively move proteins from the medial- to the cis-Golgi.

ontology.label: Golgi organization
ontology.definition: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of the Golgi apparatus.

ontology.label: protein complex scaffold activity
ontology.definition: A structural molecule activity of a protein-containing complex component that serves to hold the complex together. Protein complex scaffolds are integral members of complexes.

ontology.label: trans-Golgi network membrane
ontology.definition: The lipid bilayer surrounding any of the compartments that make up the trans-Golgi network.

ontology.label: protease binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a protease or a peptidase.

ontology.label: GTPase binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a GTPase, any enzyme that catalyzes the hydrolysis of GTP.

ontology.label: small GTPase binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a small monomeric GTPase.

ontology.label: kinase binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a kinase, any enzyme that catalyzes the transfer of a phosphate group.

ontology.label: protein-containing complex binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a macromolecular complex.

ontology.label: cytoskeletal protein binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a protein component of a cytoskeleton (actin, microtubule, or intermediate filament cytoskeleton).

ontology.label: transcription coactivator binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a transcription coactivator, a protein involved in positive regulation of transcription via protein-protein interactions with transcription factors and other proteins that positively regulate transcription. Transcription coactivators do not bind DNA directly, but rather mediate protein-protein interactions between activating transcription factors and the basal transcription machinery.

ontology.label: transcription corepressor binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a transcription corepressor, a protein involved in negative regulation of transcription via protein-protein interactions with transcription factors and other proteins that negatively regulate transcription. Transcription corepressors do not bind DNA directly, but rather mediate protein-protein interactions between repressing transcription factors and the basal transcription machinery.

ontology.label: transcription coregulator binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a transcription coregulator, a protein involved in regulation of transcription via protein-protein interactions with transcription factors and other transcription regulatory proteins. Cofactors do not bind DNA directly, but rather mediate protein-protein interactions between regulatory transcription factors and the basal transcription machinery.

ontology.label: DNA-binding transcription factor binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a DNA-binding transcription factor, a protein that interacts with a specific DNA sequence (sometimes referred to as a motif) within the regulatory region of a gene to modulate transcription.

ontology.label: transmembrane transporter binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a transmembrane transporter, a protein or protein complex that enables the transfer of a substance, usually a specific substance or a group of related substances, from one side of a membrane to the other.

ontology.label: SNARE binding
ontology.definition: Binding to a SNARE (soluble N-ethylmaleimide-sensitive factor attached protein receptor) protein.

ontology.label: retrograde transport, endosome to Golgi
ontology.definition: The directed movement of membrane-bounded vesicles from endosomes back to the trans-Golgi network where they are recycled for further rounds of transport.
